content: In love we find out who we want to be. In war we find out who we are. Based on Kristin Hannah’s global best-selling phenomenon, Elle and Dakota Fanning star in #TheNightingaleMovie — exclusively in theatres this March. Based on Kristin Hannah’s global book phenomenon — one of the bestselling novels of our time — The Nightingale stars real-life sisters Elle and Dakota Fanning together onscreen for the first time in the powerful, emotional story of two sisters forced to embark on separate courageous, dangerous paths in a fight for survival and freedom during World War II. Directed by:​​ Michael Morris​​​ ​ Screenplay by:​​​ Dana Stevens and Ann Peacock Based on the book by:​​ Kristin Hannah​ Produced by:​​​​ Dakota Fanning Elle Fanning ​​​​​Brittany Kahan Ward ​​​​​Reese Witherspoon ​​​​​Lauren Neustadter Elizabeth Cantillon Executive Producers: ​​​ Emily Ferenbach ​​​​​J. Michael Williams ​​​​​Kristin Hannah Cast: ​Elle Fanning ​Dakota Fanning ​Edmund Donovan ​Albrecht Schuch ​Shira Haas ​and Mark Rylance Credits not final This film is not yet rated by The Motion Picture Association.
